en: The image displays a hand-tinted or colorized old postcard view of a massive round stone fortress built on rocky cliffs directly above the sea. The background shows this structure continuing along the coastline, forming formidable city walls with a few buildings visible at the top. The water in the foreground reflects the fortification. The word 'Dubrovnik' is printed in red at the upper left corner.
